description: Empty states arrive part by part: the icon tile pops and its strokes draw, then the title, the description and each action rise in out of a blur.
moves: The media pops in from 0.6 and the strokes of the icon inside it draw themselves.
The title, the description and then each action rise 10px out of a blur, one after another.

propDocs.Empty.announce: Reads the title and description to screen readers when the empty state appears, as after a search that finds nothing.
propDocs.EmptyMedia.variant: "icon" puts an icon in a raised tile; "default" holds anything, like photos.
propDocs.Empty.speed: How fast the empty state moves: "fast", "normal", "slow" or a multiplier.
